title: Armstrong's money and popularity during the Depression
summary: Discussion of whether Armstrong made good money in the Depression; he was a big name and records sold everywhere.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Well, it was in there. Yeah. But the Depression we had before they started in the house, you know?

Well, I came up in the Depression. I know about the Depression. Well, was Armstrong making good money back then, during the Depression? Well, according to what things was happening at that time, you know? Good money was, I don't know what you would say called good money was-
Hundred dollars a month, I guess, something like that.
Well, he was making more money than that because he was a big name.
No, but I mean that was good money back in the Depression.
Yeah. He was making, well, he was very popular. Sure. Records were selling everywhere, every home you go in, you see it. Mm-hmm. Recorded a little.

I was talking to someone recently who told me that every time he came back, he always made it a point to go play at places where people who might not have the money to ordinarily hear him would be able to hear him.
